html:
SMTO-EXE-0082 — The clipboard action was stopped before it finished

GUID: af7a9728-2e69-5424-acb1-f6db6257d66a
Slug: clipboard-cancelled
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: clipboard

What happened

  • The clipboard action was cancelled, for example because the Task was stopped. SMTO halted before changing the clipboard.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Check whether you or someone else selected Stop on the Task. If that was intended, you don't need to do anything. Stopping a Task cancels any clipboard step that hadn't finished yet.
  2. If you still want the clipboard action, send a new message asking SMTO to do it. SMTO halted before touching the clipboard, so a new request won't repeat a change.

What success looks like

  • The new request completes and pasting on that computer shows the expected content.

If it still fails

  • If clipboard actions keep being cancelled when nobody selected Stop, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A clipboard cancellation checkpoint observed the operation's cancel signal before any clipboard effect, so the operation did not complete.

What this means

  • A bounded clipboard checkpoint observed cancellation; a possibly dispatched isolated write is instead classified with unknown effects. These operations address the selected Gateway desktop. Metadata discovery does not authorize content reads, and a native control request is not proof of completed effects; retain exact operation and target identities.

Why this can happen

  • A bounded clipboard checkpoint observed cancellation; a possibly dispatched isolated write is instead classified with unknown effects.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect operation type, cancellation phase and effect flags; a cancelled read may already have accessed content.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the original cancellation (Task stop or /clipboard/cancel for the execution_id). This receipt carries effect_unknown=false, so no clipboard change was made; a possibly dispatched isolated write would instead report clipboard_outcome_unknown. Issue a fresh explicit request only if the action is still needed.
  • Inspect the original cancellation receipt, then make a fresh explicit request only if the action is still needed.

Retry and execution caution

  • Make a new explicit request only if the clipboard action is still needed.

How to verify the fix

  • The original request is settled with no uncertain write outstanding before separately authorized new work.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay an uncertain clipboard write or include content in diagnostics.

Technical notes

  • These operations address the selected Gateway desktop. Metadata discovery does not authorize content reads, and a native control request is not proof of completed effects; retain exact operation and target identities.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
